cross_reactivity_groups.description: Patient has documented allergy to a beta-lactam antibiotic. Cross-reactivity risk of 1-10% exists with other beta-lactam antibiotics sharing the core beta-lactam ring structure.
cross_reactivity_groups.recommendation: Avoid all beta-lactam antibiotics including penicillins, cephalosporins, and carbapenems in patients with confirmed IgE-mediated penicillin allergy. Consider azithromycin or fluoroquinolone alternatives.

cross_reactivity_groups.description: Patient has documented sulfonamide antibiotic allergy. Cross-reactivity with other sulfonamide-containing antimicrobials is possible though overall risk with non-antibiotic sulfonamides is low.
cross_reactivity_groups.recommendation: Avoid sulfonamide antibiotics. Non-antibiotic sulfonamides (thiazides, celecoxib) may be used with caution as cross-reactivity is unlikely.
